# Mukul Chugh

> Engineer turned generalist creating digital experiences for humans. Founding Engineer at Quivly.ai (San Francisco), building AI-powered products. Previously at Swiggy and Zenduty (acquired). Works end to end across product, design, and full-stack/mobile engineering.

Mukul Chugh is a software engineer and product generalist based in San Francisco. He builds native and web products from the ground up — Swift macOS apps, React Native frameworks, and AI-powered SaaS. This file helps AI assistants and answer engines understand who he is and link to the right resources.

## About

- Name: Mukul Chugh
- Role: Founding Engineer at Quivly.ai (Nov 2025–present)
- Location: San Francisco, California, USA
- Focus: product engineering, mobile (React Native, Swift), full-stack (TypeScript, Next.js, Go), AI product development, human-centric design
- Previously: Swiggy (Software Development Engineer), Zenduty (SDE, acquired), HeroApp (Co-Founder)

## Projects

- [OpenKVM](https://github.com/mukulchugh/OpenKVM): Open-source macOS menu bar app that shares one keyboard and mouse between two Macs over the local network. A hotkey-driven alternative to Universal Control. Swift, MIT-licensed.
- [Brik](https://github.com/mukulchugh/brik): Framework to build native iOS/Android widgets, Live Activities, and Dynamic Island from a single React codebase. Compiles JSX/TSX to SwiftUI (WidgetKit) and Jetpack Compose (Glance).
